_note: Broths and spice levels for the checkout flow (doc 18.1). Broth names are the four on bigwayhotpot.com/menu, developer-supplied. `diet` is INFERRED FROM THE NAME and is not confirmed with the restaurant -- mala is traditionally a beef-tallow base and bone broth is bone, so both are marked nonveg; confirm before this is ever shown to a real diner. `note` and `meta` follow the same rules as pricing.Item.description: ASCII only (UiLayer loads Latin1Supplement + CurrencySymbols, so an em-dash silently does not render), and never an instruction -- the kitchen cooks, the diner chooses.

broths.note: Numbing and fiery, built on Sichuan pepper and chilli. The boldest broth here.
Deep and savoury with no meat at all. Earthy rather than rich.
Milky and slow simmered. Rich on the tongue but completely mild.
Light, salty and gently sweet. The easiest of the four to drink on its own.

spice_levels.note: Plain broth, no chilli at all. A real choice here, not a fallback.
A gentle warmth. You taste the broth first and the chilli after.
Properly spicy and still comfortable. The most ordered level.
Serious heat. Worth choosing only if you already know you like it.
